dos.title: Prepare for Galápagos entrance procedures
dos.description: Flying to Galápagos requires purchasing a Transit Control Card (TCT - $20) at Quito/Guayaquil airport and paying the park entry fee in cash.

dos.title: Acclimatize to Quito's altitude (2,850m)
dos.description: Quito is the second-highest capital in the world; take it easy on your first day, drink water, and avoid heavy exertion.

dos.title: Carry small US dollar bills ($1, $5, $10, $20)
dos.description: Merchants and taxis almost never have change for $50 or $100 bills; $1 coins are widely used and preferred.

donts.title: Don't touch wildlife in the Galápagos Islands
donts.description: Ecuadorian national park regulations mandate keeping a strict minimum distance of 2 meters from sea lions, tortoises, and iguanas.

donts.title: Don't flush toilet paper in Andean plumbing
donts.description: Plumbing pipes across historical Andean towns are narrow; always dispose of used paper in the provided wastebasket.

etiquette.tipping: A 10% service charge (propina) is often included on restaurant bills; if not included, 10% is customary for table service.
